mapper.select: SELECT mf.id, mf.object_key, mf.upload_id, mf.status, mf.access_level, mf.created_at FROM media_files mf WHERE mf.status = 'ready' AND mf.access_level = 'private' AND mf.created_at < #{deadline} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM article_media_refs r WHERE r.file_id = mf.id ) ORDER BY mf.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
